name: adr
description: Writes and maintains architecture decision records (ADRs) for a decision that has already been taken, and reads existing records before touching what they govern. Use when asked to "write an ADR", "record this decision", "document why we chose X", "why did we do it this way", "supersede an ADR", "add this to docs/adr", or to write up a call after it was made - and when about to change a subsystem whose repo has an ADR directory. Not for reaching the decision: design-forking widens and compares the options, deciding-under-uncertainty commits to one as a calibrated bet, and architecture designs the target shape.
